verification.stopped: ⏸ Join verification is disabled. New requests will not be verified automatically; administrators must review them manually.

rich_text.enabled: 🎨 Rich text output is enabled. /{g}pkg and /{g}use will send rich text messages; older or third-party clients may not display them correctly.
rich_text.disabled: 📄 Rich text output is disabled. /{g}pkg and /{g}use will send plain text messages.

name_spoiler.enabled: 🫥 Name hiding for new members is enabled. Names will use spoiler formatting so advertising names are not shown directly in the group.
name_spoiler.disabled: 👁 Name hiding for new members is disabled. Names will be shown normally.

verification_mode.current:

help.member:
🤖 Available commands:
/{g}pkg <package> — Search Gentoo packages (official tree, gentoo-zh, GURU)
/{g}use <package> — Show package details and USE flags
/{g}arm <package> — Show Gentoo arm64 keyword status

/pkgs <package> — Compare versions across distributions (also available as /distro <package>)
/armpkgs <package> — Compare arm64 support across distributions
/{g}bug <number> — Look up a Gentoo Bugzilla issue
/{g}news [keywords] — Browse or search Gentoo news
/wiki <keywords> — Search Gentoo Wiki and ArchWiki, including Chinese pages
/{g}bbs <keywords> — Search Linux forums, prioritizing Chinese results
/kernel — Kernel versions currently published on kernel.org
/man <name> — Look up a Linux manual page
/cve <id> — Look up a vulnerability by identifier
/repology <package> — Package versions across distribution repositories

/ping — Show bot status and uptime
/stats — Show today's approvals and rejections
/help — Show this list
help.admin:
👮 Administrators (reply to the target message):
/mute [duration] — Mute the user; defaults to 1h, for example /mute 30m
/unmute — Unmute the user
/ban — Ban and remove the user; delete only the replied message
/sb — Ban and remove the user; also delete all messages from that user
/warn — Warn the user; remove them automatically after %[1]d warnings
/clearwarn — Clear warnings

Other administration commands:
/settings — Open the direct-message settings panel
/bantime <duration> — Set the ban duration; 0 means permanent, for example 7d, 12h, or 30m
/autodel [on|off|minutes] — Configure automatic deletion of lookup results
/rich — Toggle rich text for /{g}pkg and /{g}use
/spoiler — Toggle name hiding for new members
/vmode <mode> — Set the verification mode: kernel, quiz, mixed, or auto
/bc — Toggle sender-channel blocking; use /bc allow|deny <channel ID> to manage the allowlist
/start or /stop — Enable or disable join verification
help.direct_message_note: The lookup commands above also work in direct messages, with a limit of %[1]d queries per minute. Review and administration commands only work in the group.

prompt.ban_duration: Send 0 for permanent, or a duration such as 30m, 12h, or 7d.
prompt.lookup_ttl: Send the lookup result lifetime in minutes (1–1440).
prompt.timeout: Send the verification timeout in seconds (30–1800).
prompt.max_fails: Send a positive maximum failure count, or off.
prompt.retry_cooldown: Send a positive retry cooldown in seconds, or off.
prompt.private_rate: Send a positive bot-wide private-query limit per minute.
prompt.invite_url: Send an HTTPS t.me link for the required channel.
prompt.channel_whitelist: Select a channel for the allowlist.
prompt.mute_duration: Send a mute duration such as 30m, 12h, or 7d.
prompt.warn_limit: Send the number of warnings before removal.
prompt.alert_chat: Choose the chat that should receive operator alerts.

error.expired: This panel is stale or expired. Reopen it with /settings.
error.authorization_lost: Administrator access was lost. Reopen the panel after access is restored.
error.authorization_check_failed: Administrator access could not be checked. Try again.
error.concurrent_change: Someone else changed these settings. Reopen the panel.
error.save_failed: The setting could not be saved. Reopen the panel and try again.
error.saved_render_failed: The setting was probably saved, but the panel could not be refreshed. Reopen the panel before making another change.
error.invalid_input: The input is not valid. Reply to the same prompt with a valid value.
error.invalid_number: Send a number in the documented range.
error.invalid_duration: Send 0 or a duration within Telegram's supported range.
error.invalid_url: Send a valid HTTPS t.me link.
error.invalid_chat: The selected chat could not be validated.
error.stale_index: The selected item changed. Reopen the panel.
error.question_needs_options: A quiz question needs at least two options and one correct option.
error.fallback_needs_answer: A fallback question needs at least one accepted answer.
error.input_blocked_verification: Finish the active verification before entering panel text.
error.input_canceled_verification: Panel input was canceled because a verification prompt became active. The reply was not graded.
error.reply_to_prompt: Reply to the exact panel prompt.
error.control_group_only: This bot-wide setting can be changed only from the control group.
error.panel_unavailable: The settings panel could not be opened. Try again.
error.whitelist_unban_failed: The channel was added to the allowlist, but its existing sender ban could not be removed.
